news.title: That 'Microsoft Support' Call Is a Scam — Hang Up Immediately
news.excerpt: Your phone rings. The caller says they are from Microsoft or Windows Support. They claim your computer has a virus, a security problem, or an expired license — and they need remote access to fix it. Sometimes they ask for a credit card or gift cards to "renew" your protection.

news.title: Fake Virus Popup Scam
news.excerpt:
Fake Virus Popup Scam

You're browsing the web and suddenly a loud siren blares from your speakers. A giant red popup fills the screen: "WARNING: 47 VIRUS DETECTED. Your files are being stolen. Call Microsoft Support NOW: 1-888-XXX-XXXX."

Here's the truth: Microsoft doesn't work this way. That popup is a webpage — just a picture. It can't see your files. It can't hurt anything. It can't make any phone calls. If you see a popup like this, close your browser tab. If it won't close, hold your…

news.title: That CAPTCHA Asking You to Press Windows+R Is a Scam
news.excerpt: A fake CAPTCHA pops up and tells you to press the Windows key + R, paste something, and hit Enter. **Don't do it.** That "verification" is a trap — it pastes malicious code into Windows Run and executes it. Real CAPTCHAs never ask for keyboard commands. Ever.

posts.title: Two Critical Vulnerabilities Added to CISA Must-Patch List — Fortinet Firewalls and BeyondTrust Remote Support
posts.summary: If your organization uses Fortinet firewalls or BeyondTrust Remote Support, apply the latest patches immediately at support.fortinet.com and beyondtrust.com/support — both fix flaws attackers are actively exploiting right now (CVE-2025-61624 and CVE-2026-102764).

posts.title: Firefox 158 Adds Smart Window Form Filling and JPEG XL Support — Free Update at firefox.com
posts.summary: Update Firefox at firefox.com or click Menu > Help > About Firefox — Smart Window now suggests form data from your open tabs and saved autofill, and JPEG XL images load faster with better quality than WebP.

posts.title: Windows Sandbox Gives You a Free Disposable PC Inside Windows — Enable It at Windows Features
posts.summary: Open Windows Features (type 'Windows Features' in Start), check Windows Sandbox, restart — you get a clean temporary desktop where anything you download, install, or break disappears when you close the window.
